answer: Trust flows down the referral graph like veins through marble: your grading weight is inherited from whoever vouched you in, traced back to the founders. A cluster of self-invited clones is an island with no bridge to that lineage, carrying zero weight no matter how loud its raven-chorus of votes. Because weight comes from provenance and not headcount, a mass of orphan identities cannot outvote a handful of rooted, earned ones.
